description: Discover Amazon's own search-autocomplete suggestions for one or more seed keywords across 23 marketplaces, with optional alphabetical, question, comparison and buyer-intent expansion.

customSuffixes.description: Additional suffixes to append to every query, e.g. ["for men", "waterproof", "iphone 15"].
customSuffixes.title: Custom suffixes

dedupe.description: Merge repeated suggestions into one record per seed, marketplace and department, with a relative volume proxy and provenance. Turn off to emit every occurrence.
dedupe.title: Deduplicate suggestions

departments.description: Amazon department aliases to scope suggestions, e.g. ["aps", "kitchen"]. Leave empty for the all-departments default (`aps`). Common aliases: aps, electronics, computers, fashion, kitchen, stripbooks, beauty, hpc, pet-supplies, toys-and-games, home-improvement, automotive, grocery, office-products, watches, shoes, luggage, digital-text, audible, amazon-devices, instant-video, todays-deals.
departments.title: Departments

excludeTerms.description: Drop suggestions containing any of these terms.
excludeTerms.title: Exclude these terms

expandAlphabet.description: Append each letter a-z to every query (e.g. `yoga mat a`) to surface more than the per-query cap.
expandAlphabet.title: Expand with suffix A-Z

expandBuyerModifiers.description: Query locale-aware buyer-intent modifiers such as `best`, `cheap`, `for men`, `for women` and `waterproof`.
expandBuyerModifiers.title: Expand with buyer modifiers

expandComparisons.description: Query comparison tokens such as `vs`, `or`, `versus` and `and` after each seed.
expandComparisons.title: Expand with comparisons

expandNumbers.description: Append each digit 0-9 to every query, useful for sizes, models and quantities.
expandNumbers.title: Expand with digits 0-9

expandPrefixAlphabet.description: Prepend each letter a-z to every query (e.g. `a yoga mat`). Returns a different suggestion set from suffix expansion.
expandPrefixAlphabet.title: Expand with prefix A-Z

expandPrepositions.description: Query preposition tokens such as `for`, `with`, `without`, `under` and `over` after each seed.
expandPrepositions.title: Expand with prepositions

expandQuestions.description: Query locale-aware question stems such as `how to`, `what is` and `where to buy` in front of each seed.
expandQuestions.title: Expand with questions

includeSeed.description: Emit one `SEED` record per seed keyword in addition to Amazon's suggestions.
includeSeed.title: Include seed as a record

includeTerms.description: Keep only suggestions containing at least one of these terms. Leave empty to keep all.
includeTerms.title: Must contain any of these terms

includeWidgets.description: Emit Amazon's optional widget suggestions (carousels, refinements, entity cards) when the enhanced endpoint returns them.
includeWidgets.title: Include widget rows

keywords.description: One or more seed keywords or phrases to expand into Amazon autocomplete suggestions.
keywords.title: Seed keywords

marketplace.description: Single Amazon marketplace to query. Used when `marketplaces` is empty.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

marketplaces.description: Optional multi-market sweep, e.g. ["US", "GB", "DE"]. Leave empty to use the single `marketplace` value. Codes are the same as the marketplace dropdown.
marketplaces.title: Multiple marketplaces

maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests. Values above 8 give little extra speed and are more likely to be rate-limited.
maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent requests

maxDepth.description: Recursively re-query newly discovered suggestions as fresh seeds, up to this depth (0 = original seeds only; 3 = three hops).
maxDepth.title: Max recursion depth

maxQueries.description: Hard cap on HTTP requests across the whole run. The run status message says when this cap stopped it.
maxQueries.title: Max queries

maxSuggestions.description: Hard cap on total records emitted in this run.
maxSuggestions.title: Max suggestions

maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.description: Cap emitted records per seed, marketplace and department. 0 means no per-seed cap.
maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.title: Max suggestions per seed

minWordCount.description: Drop suggestions with fewer words than this value.
minWordCount.title: Minimum word count

mustContainSeed.description: Drop suggestions that do not contain the original seed keyword.
mustContainSeed.title: Must contain the seed

onlyLongTail.description: Keep only suggestions with three or more words.
onlyLongTail.title: Long-tail only

onlyQuestions.description: Keep only question-shaped suggestions (question word or trailing question mark).
onlyQuestions.title: Questions only

queryMode.description: `enhanced` returns thumbnails, widgets and predictive text when Amazon provides them; `organic` is the plain keyword response; `both` requests both and unions the results.
queryMode.title: Suggestion endpoint dialect

requestDelayMs.description: Pause per worker between requests. 0 is fastest; 100-250 is gentler.
requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)

resultOrder.description: Order within each seed, marketplace and department group. `volume` sorts by the relative query-count score (requires dedupe).
resultOrder.title: Result order

title: Amazon Keyword Suggestions Scraper Input
